name: AI Document Assistant
description: Answer questions about a document or edit its content using AI. Routes between Q&A (fast) and editing (thorough) based on the user's instruction.

documentId.description: ID of the document to query or edit

instruction.description: Natural language instruction — question or edit request

mode.description: Optional override to bypass automatic intent classification

samplePayload: {"documentId":"000000000000000000000000","instruction":"Add a summary section at the top of the document"}

steps.name: Fetch Document
steps.description: Retrieve the target document content via API

steps.name: Classify Intent
steps.description: Determine whether the user wants to ask a question or edit the document

steps.name: Route: Q&A or Edit
steps.description: Route to question answering or document editing based on classification

steps.name: Answer Question
steps.description: Answer the user's question using the document content
steps.additionalInstructions:
You are answering a question about a document.

The document content is available in your input payload from the fetch-document step. Use ONLY the document content to answer the question — do not make up information.

Be concise and direct. If the document doesn't contain enough information to answer the question, say so.

Return your answer in the output.result field:
```json
{
  "answer": "Your answer here",
  "relevantSections": ["Section titles or headings that informed the answer"]
}
```

steps.name: Edit Document
steps.description: Apply the requested edit to the document content
steps.additionalInstructions:
You are editing a document based on the user's instruction.

The document content is available in your input payload from the fetch-document step. The document ID is in the input payload as 'documentId'.

IMPORTANT: Use documentOperations to update the document. Include the COMPLETE updated content — not just the changed parts.

Preserve all existing content, formatting, and structure that the user did not ask to change. Only modify what was requested.

In your response:
1. Include a documentOperations array with an 'update' action
2. The documentId should be the ID from your input payload
3. Include the full updated content in changes.content
4. Include a clear changeDescription explaining what was changed

Example documentOperations:
```json
"documentOperations": [{
  "action": "update",
  "documentId": "<the document ID from input>",
  "changes": {
    "content": "<the complete updated markdown content>"
  },
  "changeDescription": "Added summary section at the top"
}]
```

Also return a summary in your output:
```json
{
  "editSummary": "Brief description of what was changed",
  "sectionsModified": ["List of sections that were changed"]
}
```
